result:
The restricted-totals spec is fixed, but the title-reflow failure is not a product bug. It is the test host running out of disk space, so I changed no product code. The next full run will fail the same way unless you change the setup (options below).

**1. `p6-report-restricted-totals.spec.ts` (fixed)**
- It now runs on the standard stack the full suite uses, and creates its own synthetic data the way `p6-report-aggregate-label.spec.ts` does. `dev.lead` is the restricted reader, `dev.office` the admitted one, and a synthetic Benefit Owner creates two benefits in different value classes. One benefit is marked sensitive, so its whole table section is restricted for the lead. The assertions are unchanged.
- It passes in chromium-en and chromium-ar.
- It still fails without the FE-Z3 fix: I temporarily put back the old `reports/ui.tsx` and it failed in both locales with "TL totals rows 1, TO 2". The file is restored and rebuilt.
- I measured the budget under load: 9.9 s worst case against 240 s.

**2. `p5-title-reflow.spec.ts:70` (cause: disk full, not a merge)**
- **Not reproducible on a fresh stack:** it passes on HEAD in both locales.
- **Not reproducible in V9 order either:** I re-ran V9's order (all 229 en tests up to it) and it passed again.
- **Disk dropped to 283 MB free during that run.** With one worker, Playwright keeps every trace recording until the whole locale run ends, and they reached 3.1 GB. A screenshot in an unrelated spec (`p5-shell`) failed at the low point.
- **V9 matches this:**
  - the failure sits at the same position (test 229) in each locale;
  - both logs show `ENOSPC: no space left on device`;
  - one failure ended after 4.0 s, before the 5 s wait for the heading could expire.
- **The merges aren't involved.** The page heading depends only on the transformation and methodology data, and none of the merges since `9fbfea063` touched those.

**Decision for you:** `playwright.config.ts` is outside my scope, so I didn't touch it. Any of these should stop the failure (the handback has details):
- keep at least about 8 GB free before a full run (the host has 3.4 GB now);
- run the full suite with `--trace=off`;
- turn trace screenshots off in the config (I haven't measured how much that saves);
- run one Playwright call per spec file, as `e2e/support/run-spec-order.sh` does.

**Checks (all exit 0 unless noted)**
- **Gate validator:** `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` passed at start and end.
- **Static checks:** typecheck, lint, prettier, openapi lint and the full build all pass.
- **Unit tests:** `pnpm test` passes with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8: 2899, 2077 and 259 tests pass (plus 2 skipped).
- **e2e regression set, both locales:** 84 passed. It covers benefits, reports, the overview, both target specs, a15, a22 and a13.
- **Integration:** the operations, worker and job files plus the reporting sensitive-access file, run with `with-pg.sh`: 12 files, 88 tests passed.
- **Non-zero exits, all expected:**
  - the "before" run (restricted-totals failing as in V9);
  - the V9-order run (one disk-related screenshot failure);
  - the without-fix run.

**Two problems with the brief:**
- **Handback path.** The brief names `T-DG6-BE-Z8-backend-workflow-engineer.md`, which already exists and belongs to another task. I wrote to `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-Z4-frontend-ux-engineer.md` instead, with evidence in `T-DG6-FE-Z4-evidence/`.
- **Integration list.** The list of integration files to run looks copied from that same BE-Z8 brief. I ran those files anyway.

No operations were routed, and no schema, migration, dependency or en/ar text changed. Changes are left uncommitted. The screenshots (en and ar, live preview and snapshot) are in `T-DG6-FE-Z4-evidence/screenshots/`.
